name: bound-cheap-review-token-usage
title: Bound cheap review token usage
description: Add enforceable input and output token controls for the cheap PR-Agent lane.
creator: sdelmas
notes:
2026-08-15: Park re-verified against both of its premises and left in place; the resume condition e2872da recorded only in its commit message now lives in blockedOn, which is the field the work-loop inventory reads. Recorded by .trellis/tasks/08-15-parked-task-resume-conditions.
2026-08-20: Unparked by owner directive (unpark-all); park rationale preserved here. Previous blockedOn: Deliberate v2-governance scope park from e2872da (PR #60, 2026-08-08), not a dependency block. That consolidation measured 9,390 of 13,136 lines under src/ (71%) as specified by this wave but unreachable from the Action entrypoint src/index.js, with the shipped v1 core green, and concluded the real blocker is distribution rather than any missing v2 work. Resumes only when v1 is actually distributed to fleet consumers AND the v2-governance scope is deliberately revalidated as still wanted; a distribution fix alone does not unpark it. Falsify the park before resuming: re-derive reachability by walking import edges from src/index.js, and probe fleet consumers for config/routed-review-setup-v1.json. The reachability walk must follow multi-line named imports, not just single-line ones -- a newline-intolerant regex silently drops src/operation-contract.js and reports 9,662 unreachable instead of 9,390. The consumer probe is two requests per repo, in this order: GET repos/platypeeps/<repo> must return 200 to prove access, and only then does a 404 on the config path mean the file is absent. A one-request probe cannot distinguish an absent config from an unauthorized token, and the github MCP token returns repository-level 404 for all four of these private repos, so use gh. Re-verified 2026-08-15 -- reachability unchanged at 9,390/13,136, and rwbp-coordinator, loadsmith, hoa-manager and anomaly-metric-creator all 404 for that config, so zero consumers are deployed and both premises still hold. Re-verified again 2026-08-17 under the two-step probe: reachability still exactly 9,390/13,136 across 11 reachable of 19 src files, and all four consumers repo:200 config:404, so both premises hold.
